Question: 在下列实例中，分别属于相对性状和性状分离的是____
List:
①羊的长角与短腿
②水稻的非糯性和糯性
③兔的粗毛和狗的细毛
④高茎豌豆与矮茎豌豆杂交,后代全为高茎豌豆
⑤开红花的牡丹与开白花的牡丹杂交,后代全开粉红花
⑥白毛兔与白毛兔杂交后代中出现了灰毛兔
Options:
A. ②⑥
B. ②④
C. ①⑤
D. ③⑤

Need identify which are relative traits (相对性状) and which is trait segregation (性状分离), respectively. The phrase "分别属于相对性状和性状分离的是" means among instances, one belongs to relative trait and one belongs to trait segregation. Options are pairs. Likely first item in pair is relative trait, second is trait segregation. Need pick option where first is relative trait and second is trait segregation.

Definitions:
相对性状: same species, same trait, different manifestation. E.g. rice non-glutinous vs glutinous (same species, same trait seed stickiness?) yes. Sheep long horns vs short legs: same species but different traits (horn length vs leg length), not relative. Rabbit coarse hair and dog fine hair: different species, not relative.
性状分离: In offspring of a heterozygous self-cross or same phenotype parents, both dominant and recessive traits appear. Typically parents same phenotype, offspring show different phenotypes. ⑥ white rabbit x white rabbit offspring gray rabbit. Is this trait segregation? If white is dominant, heterozygous white x white can produce gray (recessive) yes. So ⑥ is trait separation. ④ tall x dwarf offspring all tall: not trait separation, just dominance. ⑤ red x white offspring all pink: incomplete dominance, not trait separation (all same new phenotype). So pair is ② and ⑥. Answer A.
